name: mark_sight_visited
description: Record that a learner has completed a sight (level). Writes a completion event to the daemon inbox so the visit is durably archived. Call this when the learner demonstrates understanding and Alice determines the sight is complete.

learner_id.description: Learner identifier — same value used in save_learner_state.

sight_title.description: Human-readable title of the sight (e.g. 'Level 3: Your First Entity').
